features.title: Your Sunburn Budget
features.body: Helia turns your skin type, the live UV index, and what you are wearing into one honest number: how much sun is safe right now. Watch it tick down as you bask, and stop before you burn — every time.

features.title: Live UV, Where You Are
features.body: Real local UV and a safe-exposure timer that respects cloud, altitude, and time of day. The safety core is free for everyone, because protecting your skin should never sit behind a paywall.

features.title: Circadian Light Coaching
features.body: Morning light anchors your body clock. Helia nudges you toward the right daylight at the right time to sleep deeper, lift your mood, and feel awake — the upside the sunscreen industry forgets to mention.

features.title: Honest Vitamin D
features.body: An evidence-based estimate of the vitamin D your sessions may have supported, given your latitude, season, and skin — so you know when you have had enough sun, and when you have not.

features.title: Trends That Tell The Truth
features.body: History and trends for exposure, burn risk avoided, and circadian consistency. No streak guilt, no maximizing — just an honest record of a healthier relationship with daylight.

features.title: Private By Design
features.body: Your skin type, location, and health signals stay on your device. Helia is an instrument you trust, so it asks for nothing it does not need and keeps what it learns to itself.

howItWorks.body: Tell Helia your skin type and a few preferences once. It builds a personal model of how much sun is safe for you, not the average.
Helia reads the live UV around you and opens your sunburn budget for the session. The timer counts your safe exposure down in real time.
Soak up the circadian, mood, sleep, and vitamin-D benefits — and stop before the burn. Over weeks, Helia coaches a healthier rhythm with daylight.

faq.q: Is Helia trying to give me a tan?
faq.a: No — and that is the point. Helia is the Oura of sunlight: a trustworthy instrument, not a maximizer. The sunburn is the enemy, not the sun. It helps you collect the genuine health upside of daylight while never letting you overdraw your safe budget.

No. Helia is a wellness instrument that estimates UV exposure and burn risk from public UV data and your inputs. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, or replace a dermatologist or doctor. If you have a skin condition or take photosensitizing medication, follow your clinician's guidance.

faq.q: How does the sunburn budget work?
faq.a: Helia combines your skin type's minimal erythemal dose with the live UV index, time of day, and conditions to estimate how long you can stay in the sun before risking a burn, then counts that budget down as you bask. It is deliberately conservative — we would rather you reapply sunscreen early than burn.

faq.q: Does Helia work without an internet connection?
faq.a: The safe-exposure timer and your budget keep running once a session starts. Live UV refreshes and coaching insights need a connection, but the core protection degrades gracefully and never leaves you stranded mid-session.
On your device. Your skin type, location, and health signals stay on the phone; Helia only ever sends what it needs to fetch UV for your area. No tracking, no ad IDs, no selling your data.
Helia runs on iPhone. No separate device or subscription bundle required.

faq.q: How do I cancel or get a refund?
faq.a: Manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your Apple ID settings; it renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Refunds are handled by Apple through your purchase history.
